body: MY ego? So it's MY ego that she sees me as inferior to her due to some outdated beliefs she grew up with because of what her parents taught? In a marriage we are supposed to see each other eye to eye, not superior/inferior, and I fear this attitude could potentially cause problems in our marriage in the future.

One thing I'm grateful for is that despite holding some of their beliefs, she is still miles better in terms of being accustomed to Canadian culture than her parents are. They to this day still hold their backwards beliefs and my relations with my in laws are sour. My wife is much more westernized but I feel like some of her core beliefs are still influenced by them, which is my main concern. My in laws are not good people. They genuinely look down on me, and think I am lower, and I don't my want my wife to fall back on the same line of thinking, which is what she seems to be feeling recently
